title: GHSL AI-agent index lists mutable-ref TOCTOU in MongoDB JS Kerberos release workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: After maintainer authorization, the release workflow checks out a mutable pull-request ref and runs pull-request-controlled scripts with a write-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN, allowing the author to race an update into the job.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index includes this advisory in its AI-discovered list. The item advisory credits only Jaroslav Lobačevski and does not describe an agent’s role; attribution is index-level only.
classification_note: The advisory documents the race and fixes; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in PR #351 on 2026-09-03. A maintainer must trigger the workflow; branch protection may restrict writes.
